nodes.name: batch-dps-regen.ts
nodes.summary: Coordinator handler that fans out completed prediction_runs into 1000-row pages for batch DPS regeneration; skeleton runSubtask returns row samples and counts pending real re-prediction wiring.

nodes.name: cross-niche-transfer.ts
nodes.summary: Coordinator handler implementing Atlas cross-niche feature transfer: picks a thinnest target niche, tests top features from adjacent data-rich niches as parallel feature_add experiments.

nodes.name: feature-discovery.ts
nodes.summary: Coordinator handler dispatching the 5-worker Atlas Feature Discovery sweep (baseline, two add candidates, weakest-remove, hyperparam) against the active deployed model with graceful degradation.

nodes.name: feature-experiment.ts
nodes.summary: Read-only coordinator handler that resolves a single brief_evaluations experiment status snapshot keyed by params.experiment_id.

nodes.name: monthly-reports.ts
nodes.summary: Coordinator handler aggregating per-agency 30-day stats (creators, briefs, predictions via creator linkage) as one subtask per agency; honest about prediction_runs lacking agency_id.

nodes.name: niche-analysis.ts
nodes.summary: Coordinator handler emitting one subtask per niche that counts cultural scans, prediction runs, and detected trends over a 14-day window.

nodes.name: platform-audit.ts
nodes.summary: Single-subtask coordinator handler producing a platform-wide snapshot count of agencies, creators, completed prediction runs, and open alerts.

nodes.name: cross-niche-transfer-finalize.ts
nodes.summary: Post-task finalizer for cross_niche_transfer coordinator tasks: upserts cross_niche_patterns confirmation/rejection lists per worker result and schedules review actions.

nodes.name: dispatcher.ts
nodes.summary: Background coordinator task dispatcher: synchronously queues a coordinator_tasks row, then runs handler subtasks in parallel via Promise.allSettled with incremental progress writes.

nodes.name: feature-discovery-finalize.ts
nodes.summary: Post-task finalizer for feature_discovery coordinator tasks: picks the best worker by delta, promotes/rejects candidate_feature rows, and enqueues a Chairman review action.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Shared TypeScript types for the parallel coordinator dispatcher: task type/status enums, CoordinatorTaskRow, CoordinatorHandler, and Subtask shapes.

nodes.name: profile_builder.ts
nodes.summary: Creator profile builder that ensures creator_profiles/creator_token_coeffs tables exist, computes 32-d caption embeddings, and rebuilds per-creator style baselines.

nodes.name: scheduler.ts
nodes.summary: In-process node-cron scheduler registering the platform's recurring jobs (training pipeline, calibration, pattern extraction, calendar refresh, cultural scans, baselines) with manual run-now entry points.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses node-cron with a module-level `started` guard so importing the scheduler multiple times only registers handlers once.

nodes.name: cascade.ts
nodes.summary: Cross-platform cascade builder grouping near-duplicate videos across TikTok/Instagram/YouTube by signature, computing leader, lag, and cross success rate.

nodes.name: identity.ts
nodes.summary: Cross-platform video identity helpers: handle normalization, caption tokenization, duration bucketing, and signature/equality functions used to cluster videos across platforms.

nodes.name: predict.ts
nodes.summary: Deterministic logistic-based predictor estimating per-platform success probability and recommended publishing lags for cross-platform reposts.

nodes.name: service.ts
nodes.summary: Cross-platform service layer: bootstraps fixtures, builds/summarizes cascades from data sources, persists predictions to disk, and exposes a seed-driven prediction helper.

nodes.name: queries.ts
nodes.summary: Server-side Supabase queries powering the agency dashboard: stats summary, creator list, alerts, briefs with status counts, coaching insights, and pending invites.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Database barrel that instantiates the project's shared Supabase DatabaseClient via createSupabaseClient and re-exports the common types.

nodes.name: loggedDb.ts
nodes.summary: Wraps the shared Supabase client with per-operation logger.logInput/logOutput instrumentation for tracing select/insert/update/delete calls.

nodes.name: sandbox-database.ts
nodes.summary: Sandbox-environment Supabase wrapper with TTL in-memory caching, schema bootstrap, and CRUD for sandbox users, predictions, templates, workflow sessions, and analytics events.

nodes.name: supabase-viral-prediction.ts
nodes.summary: Type-safe Supabase data-access layer for the viral prediction platform exposing ViralPredictionDB with CRUD for videos, predictions, templates, validation runs, and system metrics.

nodes.name: supabase.ts
nodes.summary: Instantiates the public Supabase client from env vars and provides a thin SupabaseQueryBuilder adapter conforming to the project's DatabaseClient interface.

nodes.name: SupabaseService.ts
nodes.summary: Object-oriented service exposing template-related Supabase reads (e.g. getPublishedTemplates) with a strongly-typed TemplateRecord shape.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Shared database-layer interfaces (QueryResult, DatabaseClient, QueryBuilder, AuthClient, StorageClient) abstracting the underlying Supabase API.

nodes.name: finalizeCrossNicheTransferTask
nodes.summary: Idempotently reconciles a finished cross_niche_transfer task by upserting cross_niche_patterns confirmed/rejected lists per candidate and scheduling a review action.

nodes.name: startTask
nodes.summary: Public entry that synchronously inserts a queued coordinator_tasks row and kicks off background subtask execution, returning the task id to the caller.

nodes.name: runInBackground
nodes.summary: Background driver that resolves a handler, breaks the task into subtasks, runs them in parallel with Promise.allSettled, and finalizes the coordinator_tasks row.

nodes.name: writeProgress
nodes.summary: Writes an incremental progress snapshot to coordinator_tasks.output_result.progress so the UI can poll live subtask completion counts.

nodes.name: finalizeFeatureDiscoveryTask
nodes.summary: Idempotently finalizes a feature_discovery task by picking the best worker, promoting or rejecting candidate_feature rows by delta, and scheduling a Chairman review.

nodes.name: ensureCreatorTables
nodes.summary: Best-effort RPC call that creates the creator_profiles and creator_token_coeffs tables if a Supabase exec_sql helper is available.

nodes.name: rebuildCreatorProfile
nodes.summary: Recomputes a creator's niche, follower band, caption-style embedding, and baseline completion/share metrics from recent videos and upserts the profile.

nodes.name: computeAndInsertMetrics
nodes.summary: Computes nightly evaluation metrics across recent prediction runs and inserts the aggregated row into the metrics table.

nodes.name: getLastRuns
nodes.summary: Returns the most recent run timestamps for each registered scheduled job, used by status APIs and the operations dashboard.

nodes.name: scheduleJob
nodes.summary: Internal helper that wraps a job handler in error logging and registers it with node-cron under a named expression.

nodes.name: startScheduler
nodes.summary: Module bootstrap that idempotently registers all recurring jobs (calibration, training, pattern extraction, calendar refresh, cultural scans, baselines, etc.) with node-cron.

nodes.name: stopScheduler
nodes.summary: Stops the in-process node-cron scheduler and resets the registry, used during shutdown or test teardown.

nodes.name: runEvalScript
nodes.summary: Spawns the offline Python evaluation script as a child process and returns when it exits, used by the nightly evaluation job.

nodes.name: runNightlyEvalNow
nodes.summary: Manual entry point that triggers the nightly evaluation pipeline immediately and records the last-run timestamp.

nodes.name: runWeeklyBaselinesNow
nodes.summary: Manual entry point that recomputes per-cohort weekly baselines on demand outside the scheduled cron window.

nodes.name: runCalibrationJob
nodes.summary: Triggers the calibration training job over the last 30 days of prediction runs and updates the calibration model artifacts.

nodes.name: runScheduleBackfillNow
nodes.summary: Manually runs the training schedule backfill that re-anchors metric collection windows for older prediction runs.

nodes.name: runMetricCollectorNow
nodes.summary: Manually runs the post-publish metric collector that pulls Apify view/engagement data for tracked videos.

nodes.name: runAutoLabelerNow
nodes.summary: Manually runs the lenient auto-labeler that converts collected post-publish metrics into VPS training labels.

nodes.name: runSpearmanEvalNow
nodes.summary: Manually triggers the Spearman rank correlation evaluator that measures predicted vs actual VPS over the labeled set.

nodes.name: runDiscoveryScanNow
nodes.summary: On-demand niche discovery scan that runs the fresh-video scanner for a specified niche key.

nodes.name: runNicheCreatorScrapeNow
nodes.summary: On-demand scrape of niche-specific creators (via the niche creator scraper) for one or more provided niches.

nodes.name: runPatternExtractionJob
nodes.summary: Scheduled job body that extracts viral patterns from recent labeled data and persists them to the patterns store.

nodes.name: runPatternExtractionNow
nodes.summary: Manual entry point that triggers pattern extraction immediately and records the last-run timestamp.

nodes.name: runCalendarRefreshNow
nodes.summary: Manually refreshes the cultural content calendar (cultural scan inputs) used by predictions and dashboards.

nodes.name: runPatternMetricsNow
nodes.summary: Manually recomputes per-pattern usage and success metrics over recent labeled data for the patterns dashboard.

nodes.name: computeAndStorePublicBaseline
nodes.summary: Computes and persists a public-facing baseline metric snapshot used by the marketing site and dashboards.

nodes.name: runCulturalScanViaApi
nodes.summary: Invokes the cultural-scan cron route via internal HTTP fetch so the production code path is exercised consistently with Vercel cron.

nodes.name: runCulturalScanNow
nodes.summary: Manual entry that triggers the cultural-scan job for a given niche and updates the last-run timestamp.

nodes.name: runEventClassifierViaApi
nodes.summary: Invokes the event-classifier cron route via internal HTTP fetch, mirroring the Vercel-cron execution path.

nodes.name: runEventClassifierNow
nodes.summary: Manual entry that triggers the event-classifier job for a given niche and records the last-run timestamp.

nodes.name: runAutoDreamViaApi
nodes.summary: Invokes the auto-dream agency cron endpoint via internal HTTP fetch for the given agency id.

nodes.name: runAutoDreamNow
nodes.summary: Manual entry that triggers the auto-dream agency pipeline immediately for the supplied agency id.

nodes.name: runMemoryConsolidationViaApi
nodes.summary: Invokes the agency memory-consolidation cron route via internal HTTP fetch for the given agency id.

nodes.name: runMemoryConsolidationNow
nodes.summary: Manual entry that triggers agency memory consolidation immediately and records the last-run timestamp.

nodes.name: buildCascadesRaw
nodes.summary: Builds raw cross-platform cascade groupings from a video source by filtering, signing, clustering by signature, and computing leader/lag/cross success rate.

nodes.name: videoSignature
nodes.summary: Computes a stable video signature combining caption-derived text signature, audio signature, and duration bucket used to match videos across platforms.

nodes.name: isSameVideo
nodes.summary: Determines whether two VIT records represent the same video across platforms by comparing duration bucket plus normalized text/audio signatures.

nodes.name: predictCrossPlatform
nodes.summary: Predicts IG/YT success probability and recommended posting lags from a leader-platform video using a deterministic logistic feature blend.

nodes.name: ensureCrossFixtures
nodes.summary: Creates the cross-platform fixtures directory and seeds initial cascades.json/predictions.json files if missing.

nodes.name: buildCascades
nodes.summary: Loads videos from the requested data source (mock or live) and returns cross-platform cascades filtered by window/niche/creator parameters.

nodes.name: summarize
nodes.summary: Aggregates a set of cascades into summary statistics (counts by leader platform, mean lags, cross success rate) for the dashboard view.

nodes.name: getAgencyStats
nodes.summary: Returns the agency dashboard stats card (active creators, average VPS, weekly content, pending briefs) for the given agency id.

nodes.name: getAgencyCreatorsList
nodes.summary: Fetches the agency's creator roster with per-creator status, niche, and lightweight performance metadata for the dashboard list view.

nodes.name: getAgencyAlerts
nodes.summary: Returns open chairman alerts for the agency along with derived severity flags used by the dashboard alerts panel.

nodes.name: getAgencyBriefs
nodes.summary: Loads recent content_briefs for the agency along with status counts, recipient breakdown, and per-creator association used by the briefs view.

nodes.name: getCoachingInsights
nodes.summary: Derives coaching insight summaries (strengths, opportunities, top patterns) per creator for the agency dashboard coaching panel.

nodes.name: getAgencyInvites
nodes.summary: Returns pending invite rows for the agency dashboard invites panel filtered by agency id.

nodes.name: SandboxDatabase
nodes.summary: Sandbox-environment Supabase wrapper providing schema bootstrap, TTL caching, and CRUD for sandbox users, viral predictions, templates, workflow sessions, and analytics events.

nodes.name: ViralPredictionDB
nodes.summary: Type-safe data-access class for the viral prediction platform covering videos, predictions, templates, optimization suggestions, validation runs, and system metrics.

nodes.name: SupabaseQueryBuilder
nodes.summary: Thin adapter mapping the project's QueryBuilder interface onto the underlying Supabase fluent query API.

nodes.name: SupabaseService
nodes.summary: Service class exposing template-related Supabase reads (e.g. getPublishedTemplates) with strongly-typed TemplateRecord results.
